text.en:
Section 4 of Executive Order No. 121, dated September 06, 2002
is hereby amended to read as follows;
"SECTION 4. Secretariat- The Council shall reorganize its
Secretariat to be headed by an Executive Director who shall be the
Current head of the Secretariat on Territorial Concerns of the Department
of Foreign Affairs (DFA)"
All orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof which
are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed of modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila this [7TH day of MAY
in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Three.
By the Pi asident:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
